title: Normalized shift and exactness data for the étale Hom comparison
statement: For a scheme X, a map of commutative rings A→B and a derived A-module M, there are normalized CommShift structures for the two derived Hom functors and the two evaluation comparison functors. Their signed evaluation normalizations hold, the scalar-extension and Hom compositions have the displayed shift equations, and both compositions are triangulated. This is the shift and functor-exactness component of the reversed exactness assertion.

source.place: Tags 08JA, 08J9 and 08JC: Hom model, evaluation and contravariant exactness

proof.text: Obtain the normalized shift structures, the right component equation, and both triangulated structures from the strictly smaller shift-core statement. The left component equation is the canonical composition formula for Functor.CommShift.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08JC and 08J9: signed Hom shifts and contravariant exactness

lean.statement:
theorem etaleHomComparison_reversedExact_shiftData
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (φ : A →+* B) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) :
    letI := etaleHomScalarCommShift X φ
    ∃ (sA : ((derivedHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).flip.obj M).CommShift ℤ)
      (sB : ((derivedHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) X).flip.obj
        ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M)).CommShift ℤ)
      (_chiPhi : (EtaleHomLeft X φ M).CommShift ℤ)
      (_chiPsi : (EtaleHomRight X φ M).CommShift ℤ),
      EtaleHomShiftNormalization (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X M sA ∧
      EtaleHomShiftNormalization (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) X ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M) sB ∧
      (∀ (K : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (n : ℤ),
        ((EtaleHomLeft X φ M).commShiftIso n).hom.app (op K) =
          (scalarExtension φ X).map ((sA.commShiftIso n).hom.app (op K)) ≫
            ((scalarExtension φ X).commShiftIso n).hom.app
              (((derivedHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).flip.obj M).obj (op K))) ∧
      (∀ (K : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (n : ℤ),
        ((EtaleHomRight X φ M).commShiftIso n).hom.app (op K) =
          ((derivedHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) X).flip.obj
              ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M)).map
            ((((scalarExtension φ X).commShiftIso (-n)).inv.app K).op) ≫
          (sB.commShiftIso n).hom.app (op ((scalarExtension φ X).obj K))) ∧
      (EtaleHomLeft X φ M).IsTriangulated ∧
      (EtaleHomRight X φ M).IsTriangulated
